readout_other: multichannel ECoG; ultrasound-evoked potentials, omega complexity, phase-amplitude coupling
direction_notes: Thalamic TUS evoked cortical potentials whose amplitude increased and omega complexity decreased with isoflurane concentration (0.5-2.0%); no excitation/inhibition assessment.

timing.protocol_description: Trigger frequency 3 ± Δt s (Δt random 0-1 s), stimulation duration 50 ms, PRF 1 kHz, duty cycle 40%, 500 kHz; five minutes of stimulated ECoG recorded at each of four isoflurane concentrations (2.0, 1.5, 1.0, 0.5%).

source_quotes.n_subjects: Fig. 5 shows the averaged UEPs of nine rats
